summary: WorksheetGroups manages groupings for worksheet entries, facilitating batch operations and reporting on placements, site-instructor assignments, shift schedules, and requests. The content covers data models, business rules, workflows, and system behaviors for group creation, editing, deletion, searching, and reporting.
purpose: To enable group-based management of worksheet entries, allowing bulk operations, reporting, and integration with placement requests, site profiles, and related entities. It supports workflows for batch copying, updating, scheduling, and reporting on group-based placements.

workflows.name: Group Worksheet Search
steps: Accept parameters: groupFlag, cohortID, termID, courseID, siteID, instructorFilter, dateFilter, serviceCodeID, cfoMode, agencyID, governingOrgID, courseUsesBlocks, block, multipleStatusList, draftFilter
Retrieve cohort terms and set termStartDate and programDisciplineID
Iterate through records and build WorksheetGroup entries
Calculate statistical totals (requested, sent, accepted, confirmed, rotations)

workflows.name: Group Worksheet Accepted
steps: Call stored procedure 'GroupWorksheetAccepted' with parameters for acceptance filtering

workflows.name: Group Worksheet Delete
steps: Iterate through groups, delete if PRExists is false

workflows.name: Group Worksheet Copy Previous Term
steps: Copy entries from prior term into new term for batch operations

workflows.name: Send To Destination (Reporting)
steps: Prepare print jobs, letters, or schedules
Close or delete print jobs as needed

business_rules: If instructorID is 0, set InstructorNameFormatted to ALL; if -1, set to Unassigned; else use named instructor
If siteID, governingOrgID, serviceID, campusID are 0, set corresponding fields to ALL
GroupFlag determines batch behavior vs individual records
Multiple instructors and preceptors are formatted and shown if present
ShowCalendarGridIcon only if PRD_ID and DestinationID are valid and PRStatus is not DECA/CANC
RequireRequestCode is enforced at entry level
Closure warnings are displayed based on ClosureWarningDates
validations: Requested and Sent counts must be positive integers
Instructor, site, service, destination, and campus IDs validated for presence and type
Status codes are formatted and checked for business meaning
calculations: Stats: RequestTotal, CreatedTotal, AcceptedTotal, ConfirmedCount, GroupRotationTotal, RequestRotationTotal, CreatedRotationTotal, AcceptedRotationTotal, AcceptedOfferCount
Derived fields: RequestedFormatted, AcceptedFormatted, PRD_IDFormatted, RotationIndicatorFormatted
conditions: If UseCallForOffers is true and CFOWorksheetGroupID is 0, entry is CFO parent
If PRStatus is DECA or CANC, reporting and icons are disabled
If entry has AmendmentExists, icon and warning is shown
system_behavior: Bulk group operations are supported (add, update, delete, copy)
Print job and reporting integration for outputs
Validation and warnings for over-capacity, closure conflicts, and missing data
Dynamic formatting for UI fields and icons
dependencies: Sites and Agencies for site/agency dropdowns
Database and stored procedures for all CRUD and reporting operations
exceptions: No PRs or entries found leads to warning messages
SQLErrorOccured triggers error messages on print job operations
